purpose: Pre-register the ARN v3 instance-paired reducer successor BEFORE touching any confirmatory data. All parameters and thresholds are frozen. Hard falsifier ordering: B3 (shuffled gold) runs FIRST.

parent_v2_attribution.deficit: scoring used label-INDEPENDENT type marginals, surviving gold shuffling
parent_v2_attribution.artifact: B3_shuffled_gold advantage 0.121 [0.091, 0.150] when it should be ~0
parent_v2_attribution.leverage: make scoring instance-paired: every score term must consume the joint (source-instance, target-instance) assignment, not marginals from one narrative alone

successor_description: ARN v3 reducer with instance-paired mapping. NO language model, NO network, deterministic rules only. Scoring rewards specific query-instance to candidate-instance correspondences; no component computable from one side alone.
author: RAKL programme (same-context; LLM-assisted)

extraction.description: Reuse v2 extraction verbatim: typed roles, typed relations, negation scope. All v2 extraction parameters preserved.

mapping.description: Scoring is strictly instance-paired: every score term consumes a specific (query-instance, candidate-instance) pair. No marginal components computable from one narrative alone. Shuffling gold labels breaks pairings and collapses advantage BY CONSTRUCTION.

correspondence_function.role_correspondence: c_role(q_r, c_r) = 1 if q_r.token == c_r.token, 0.4 if q_r.token != c_r.token AND q_r.role_type == c_r.role_type != NONE, 0 otherwise
correspondence_function.relation_correspondence: c_rel(q_rel, c_rel) = 1 if q_rel.source.token == c_rel.source.token AND q_rel.target.token == c_rel.target.token, 0.5 if tokens differ AND role_types match pairwise AND relation_types match, 0 otherwise

scoring_formula.roles: role_score = (sum over max(1 matched candidate per query role)) of c_role(q_r, matched_c_r) / |query_roles|
scoring_formula.relations: relation_score = (sum over max(1 matched candidate per query relation)) of c_rel(q_rel, matched_c_rel) / |query_relations|

matching_rule.description: Each query instance matches at most one candidate instance (asymmetric, query-centric). Greedy assignment by correspondence strength: for each query role/relation, select the highest-correspondence candidate not already matched, break ties by position.
matching_rule.formal: matching: query_instances -> candidate_instances, injective, maximizing sum of correspondence values

mapping.theta_w_fit: DEV grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.05, maximize decidable exact accuracy (same as parent)
mapping.acceptance_rule: ACCEPT iff score >= theta_w, else REJECT

instance_paired_verification.test: For any score component s, there is no way to compute s from query alone or candidate alone. Every term depends on a specific pairing (q_i, c_j).
instance_paired_verification.shuffling_property: Shuffling candidate labels (permuting candidate roles/relations) changes the matching and thus the score. Advantage on shuffled-gold must be ~0 by construction.

CANNOT_CHECK_conditions.rule: query has < 2 roles OR 0 relations OR candidate has < 2 roles OR 0 relations
fraction of typed roles (role_type != NONE) in query < 0.2 AND fraction of typed relations (relation_type != PLAIN) in query < 0.1

abstention.rationale: Same abstention thresholds as v2, but with zero-correspondence check added for instance-paired mapping.

admission.sample_sources: the query texts of the first 8 groups in frozen split order (same as parent)

baseline_to_beat.target: beat band_control 0.506 confirmatory exact accuracy, AND B3_shuffled_gold advantage CI must contain 0

revival_strategy.hypothesis: Instance-paired correspondence scoring (specific query-instance to candidate-instance matching) will not survive label shuffling, making B3_shuffled_gold advantage ~0 by construction. This repairs the v2 deficit where type marginals survived shuffling.

hard_falsifier_ordering.description: B3 (shuffled-gold negative control) runs FIRST. If B3 fails again (advantage CI does not contain 0), STOP at NEGATIVE__BATTERY_FAILED with measured artifact. Never run confirmatory gates with a failed battery.
hard_falsifier_ordering.stop_condition: If B3_shuffled_gold g1_fails_as_required == false, TERMINAL at NEGATIVE__BATTERY_FAILED__INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE

evaluation.scoring: same Brier scoring, same bootstrap CI (10,000 resamples, seed 20260814), same G1/G2/G3 gates as parent protocol

terminals: NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT (B3 passes but fails to beat band_control)
nonclaims: independent review (same-context analysis over third-party labels)
